name: McKinney Towne Crossing​
summary: McKinney Towne Crossing is a well-positioned community shopping center located at Highway 121 and Custer Road in McKinney, Texas. Situated in one of the fastest-growing areas in North Texas, the center serves a thriving residential and commercial market with convenient highway access.
demographics: McKinney Towne Crossing serves the rapidly growing McKinney area, one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area draws young professionals and established families, typically aged 25-54, who have relocated to the area for its excellent schools and quality of life. The center benefits from its strategic location at Highway 121 and Custer Road, positioned within a booming commercial and residential corridor that continues to experience significant population growth and new development.
description: McKinney Towne Crossing is a premier community shopping center strategically positioned at the northeast corner of Highway 121 (Sam Rayburn Tollway) and Custer Road in McKinney, Texas. Located within one of the fastest-growing areas in North Texas, this center serves the thriving McKinney community with convenient access to both residential neighborhoods and major transportation corridors. The property is managed by Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRPLT), a nationally recognized real estate investment trust known for developing and operating high-quality retail properties. With its prime location in the heart of McKinney's commercial district, the center benefits from the city's explosive growth and strong economic fundamentals. The shopping center offers ample leasing opportunities for retailers looking to establish a presence in this dynamic and affluent market, with professional property management and modern facilities designed to meet the needs of both tenants and shoppers.
